svg.title: Your first conversation with Codex
svg.desc: Selected excerpts from the observed v1.0.0 first-use conversation. Developer: start. Codex: Hi, I’m here to help you shape the project and work through its AWS decisions. I’ll check the saved context and repository first so we can build on what’s already in place.. Setup summary: local setup passed; the brief and handoff were updated. Codex: What should this project help people do, and who will use it first?. This is a transcript illustration, not an original screenshot.

g.text: Hi, I’m here to help you shape the project and work through
its AWS decisions. I’ll check the saved context and repository
first so we can build on what’s already in place.
Local setup passed · Project brief and handoff updated
What should this project help people do,
and who will use it first?
